hero.title: How it compares
hero.lede: A cloud chatbot is quick to set up. A helpdesk is familiar, and an agency gives you real people. None of them looks up the order and acts on it within your limits.

image.alt: A large telephone exchange with rows of operators.

items.title: You need it live today
items.text: Customers can't reach Crewline from your site yet. A hosted widget can be running by tonight.

items.title: You need Shopify in real time
items.text: Crewline imports CSV files. A connected app sees orders the moment they change.

items.title: You want a person on every ticket
items.text: An agency or a helpdesk is the honest choice.

items.title: You have no spare computer
items.text: Something has to stay on to answer. Cloud tools don't need that.

items.title: You want refunds to run themselves
items.text: Today it records them and you press the button in your store.
